items.definition:
something that suppresses or inhibits
The new drug acts as a suppressor of the immune response.

truthfulness or accuracy
The police questioned the veracity of his statement.

a female fox; a quarrelsome or malicious woman
The vixen led her cubs to the den.

a synthetic, addictive, mood-altering drug
Amphetamine is a powerful stimulant.

a system of complementary medicine focused on diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders
She sought chiropractic treatment for her back pain.

the citizens of a place regarded collectively
The government is responsible for the well-being of its citizenry.

the transparent outer layer of the eye
Light enters the eye through the cornea.

the process of reducing pressure
Divers must undergo decompression to avoid the bends.

a reduction in the general level of prices in an economy
The country is currently experiencing economic deflation.

the branch of medicine concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of skin disorders
She decided to specialize in dermatology after medical school.

a level or rank in an organization
He quickly rose through the echelons of the company.

a large, imposing building
The ancient edifice stood majestically on the hill.

a person living outside their native country
Many expatriates choose to retire in warmer climates.

a litter of pigs
The sow gave birth to a large farrow of piglets.

a small sac or cavity in the body, especially one from which hair grows
Hair grows from a tiny follicle in the skin.

a soft white mineral, often used in plaster
Plaster of Paris is made from gypsum.

the care, cultivation, and breeding of crops and animals
Good animal husbandry is essential for a healthy farm.

exaggerated statements or claims not meant to be taken literally
His description of the meal was pure hyperbole.

the profession or practice of assisting women in childbirth
She decided to pursue a career in midwifery.

a person's social environment
He grew up in a creative and artistic milieu.

a particular way or method of doing something
The criminal's modus operandi was always the same.

a title of honor bestowed upon certain Roman Catholic priests
Monsignor Smith delivered the sermon.

the study and treatment of eye diseases
He decided to specialize in ophthalmology.

a cloth spread over a coffin, hearse, or tomb; a dark, gloomy atmosphere
A pall of smoke hung over the city.

a feeling of irritation or resentment resulting from a slight, especially to one's pride
He left in a fit of pique.

the action of reviving someone from unconsciousness or apparent death
Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) is a life-saving technique.

the official cancellation of a decree, decision, or promise
The revocation of his license meant he could no longer drive.

the action of taking legal possession of assets until a debt has been paid or other claims have been met; the action of isolating or hiding away
The jury was under sequestration during the high-profile trial.

magnificent and splendid appearance; grandeur
The palace was decorated with great splendour.

the action of clearing someone of blame or suspicion
The verdict was a complete vindication of his innocence.

a high-ranking cleric in the Twelver Shi'a Islam
The Grand Ayatollah issued a new religious decree.

A summary of the principles of Christian religion in the form of questions and answers, used for the instruction of Christians.
Children often learn the basic tenets of their faith through a catechism.

A shrill, narrow-tubed war trumpet; a clear and inspiring message or sound.
The clarion call for freedom echoed through the streets.

A strongbox or small chest for holding valuables; a country's financial reserves.
The king's coffers were filled with gold and jewels.

An informal and often derogatory term for a communist.
During the Cold War, the term "commie" was often used pejoratively.

A dog of mixed breed; a contemptible man.
The old farmer's cur barked at every stranger.

Distributed Denial of Service
The website was brought down by a DDoS attack.

scarcity
There is a dearth of qualified teachers in the rural areas.

mild expression
'Passed away' is a euphemism for 'died'.

musical composition
The pianist performed a beautiful fantasia.

intense controversy
The politician's comments caused a media firestorm.

ancestor
Our forefathers fought for freedom.

a strict adherence to a set of beliefs
Religious fundamentalism can lead to intolerance.

a protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen
Hemoglobin is essential for transporting oxygen in the blood.

a secluded residence or retreat
He lived in a small hermitage deep in the woods.

lack of voluntary control over urination or defecation
Urinary incontinence is a common condition among older adults.

an integrated circuit that contains all the functions of a central processing unit of a computer
The new computer features a powerful microprocessor for faster performance.

a period of reflection or thought
His latest book is a collection of philosophical musings on life and death.

the state or quality of a material or membrane that causes it to allow liquids or gases to pass through it
The permeability of the soil affects water drainage.

an uneasy feeling of doubt, worry, or fear, especially about one's own conduct; a misgiving
He had no qualms about lying to protect his friend.

The state of being private and away from other people
She enjoyed the peace and seclusion of her cabin in the woods.

A condition or requirement that is specified or demanded as part of an agreement
One of the stipulations of the contract was a non-disclosure agreement.

The process of summing or adding things up; a summary
The lawyer gave a summation of the evidence.

A group of models or motionless figures representing a scene from a story or from history
The final scene of the play ended in a dramatic tableau.

An act that goes against a law, rule, or code of conduct; an offense
His transgression against the rules resulted in a penalty.

a person holding a fief in feudal times
The king demanded loyalty from his vassals.

the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions
Her business acumen was evident in her successful ventures.

the quality of being relevant or appropriate
The applicability of this theory to real-world problems is limited.

a robot; a person who acts in a mechanical way
The old clockwork automaton moved with surprising grace.

a mineral consisting of a silicate of beryllium and aluminum
Emeralds and aquamarines are varieties of beryl.

the rear part of the barrel of a firearm; the lower part of the trunk of the body
The rifle's breech mechanism was designed for quick reloading.

the chief Muslim civil and religious ruler, regarded as the successor of Muhammad
The caliph ruled over a vast Islamic empire.

the state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations
The priest took a vow of celibacy.

a high court of equity; the office of a chancellor
The case was heard in the Court of Chancery.
